title: Bedrockless Deepslate
description: This mod prevents you from leaking your base cords with bedrock
body: im sure it happend to all of us, playing donut smp livestreaming it to hundreds of fans and then, one mistake and boom, you acidentaly leaked your base, by looking at bedrock, well this texturepack changes Bedrock texture to Deepslate texture, preventing your from acidentaly leaking your base cords
